name: Manali & Kasol
shortDescription: Pine forests, river streams & mountain music.
description: Himachal's iconic mountain escape. Experience Old Manali cafe culture, Solang snow sports, Atal Tunnel Lahaul view, and Kasol riverside campfires.

name: Kedarnath Dham
shortDescription: Isn't just a destination. It's a journey you'll remember.
description: Nestled among snow-draped Himalayan mountains in Garhwal Uttarakhand, Kedarnath offers a profound spiritual trek combined with majestic nature.

name: Spiti Valley
shortDescription: High passes, ancient monasteries & moon lakes.
description: The cold high-altitude desert of Himachal Pradesh home to ancient Tibetan monasteries, Hikkim highest post office, and turquoise Chandratal Lake.

name: Mystic Meghalaya
shortDescription: Cloudy mountains, crystal rivers & root bridges.
description: Discover Northeast India's rain paradise — transparent Umngot River in Dawki, Cherrapunjee waterfalls, and Double Decker Living Root Bridges.

name: Nepal & Muktinath
shortDescription: Himalayan peaks, serene lakes & sacred temples.
description: A breathtaking cross-border journey to Kathmandu, Pokhara, and holy Muktinath Temple amidst Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain views.

name: Tirupati Balaji
shortDescription: Divine blessings at Lord Venkateswara's abode.
description: Experience divine South Indian temple heritage at Sri Venkateswara Temple Tirumala, Kalahasti Temple, and Padmavathi Temple.

title: Manali & Kasol Group Trip
shortDescription: Himachal's perfect mix of mountains, rivers, cafés, adventure and unforgettable group experiences.

children.text: Explore Kasol, Manali, Kullu, Solang Valley, Sissu, Atal Tunnel, Old Manali, Manikaran, Chalal, and Jogini Waterfall with a close-knit group of fellow travelers.

accommodation: 1N Riverside Stay in Kasol + 2N 3-Star Manali Hotel
inclusions: 1 Night Riverside / Hippie Stay in Kasol
2 Nights in 3-star Valley View Manali Hotel
AC Semi-Sleeper Volvo Bus between Delhi and Manali
Internal transfers by Ertiga / Tempo Traveller
exclusions: Paragliding, ATV rides, River rafting fees

children.text: Pickup from Delhi in the evening. Meet fellow travelers and enjoy an overnight Volvo journey towards Parvati Valley with group games and icebreakers.
Check in to Kasol stay. Walk across Chalal Bridge, chill along Parvati River, visit local cafes and Manikaran Sahib hot springs. Enjoy a cozy bonfire night.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Manali & Old Manali Culture

children.text: Post breakfast, transfer to Manali. Taste local Siddu, visit Hadimba Temple, Buddhist Monastery, Mall Road, and famous Old Manali cafes.
Short hike to Jogini Waterfall. Drive through the iconic Atal Tunnel into Lahaul's Sissu Valley. Enjoy ATV rides, zorbing and snow sports in Solang Valley.
Drive along Beas River to Kullu. Experience white water river rafting and paragliding. Evening departure towards Delhi in AC Volvo.
Arrival in Delhi early morning. Continue onward train/flight travel to Mumbai with lifelong trip memories.

importantInformation.title: Preparation Notes
details: Sleeper / AC / Double Sharing package options available.
Pack warm clothes for evening temperatures in Kasol and Manali.

title: Char Dham Yatra (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath)
shortDescription: A sacred Himalayan pilgrimage covering Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath.

children.text: Journey across the holy shrines of Uttarakhand: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath, passing through Mussoorie, Barkot, Uttarkashi, Guptkashi, Pipalkoti, Joshimath, and Mana Village.

accommodation: Standard Hotels & Guest Houses across pilgrim hubs
inclusions: Transfers from Haridwar in Tempo Traveller / Private Vehicle
11 Nights Accommodation (Barkot, Uttarkashi, Guptkashi, Kedarnath, Pipalkoti, Haridwar)
Tolls, parking, driver allowance and fuel

children.text: Pickup from Haridwar. Scenic drive to Barkot via Mussoorie and Kempty Falls. Hotel check-in and group dinner.
Drive to Janki Chatti. 5 km trek each way to Yamunotri Temple and Jamnabai Kund. Return to Barkot.
Visit Prakateshwar Mahadev Temple and Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Uttarkashi.
Excursion to Gangotri Temple along the holy Bhagirathi River. Darshan and return to Uttarkashi.
Himalayan drive to Guptkashi. Visit Vishwanath & Ardhanarishwar temples.
Drive to Sitapur/Sonprayag. Begin 22 km trek to Kedarnath Dham. Evening Aarti at Kedarnath Temple.
Morning Darshan at Kedarnath. Trek down to Sonprayag and drive back to Guptkashi.
Scenic mountain drive towards Pipalkoti/Joshimath with Chopta views.
Darshan at Badrinath Temple and Tapt Kund. Visit Mana - the last Indian village, Vyas Gufa, Bhim Pul & Saraswati River origin.
Visit Devprayag Sangam and Rishikesh en route to Haridwar for onward return to Mumbai.

importantInformation.title: Medical & Permits
details: Mandatory biometric registration for Char Dham Yatra.
Carry physical Aadhaar card and required personal medications.

title: Spiti Valley Explorer Road Trip
shortDescription: High passes, ancient monasteries, remote Himalayan villages and unforgettable off-road adventures.

children.text: Traverse high passes, ancient monasteries, remote Himalayan villages, and Chandratal Lake. Route: Shimla → Kalpa → Sangla → Chitkul → Nako → Gue → Tabo → Dhankar → Kaza → Kibber → Chicham → Key Monastery → Langza → Komic → Hikkim → Kunzum Pass → Chandratal → Manali.

accommodation: Standard Hotels, Kinnaur Homestays & Chandratal Camps
inclusions: Tempo Traveller for entire Spiti circuit
9 Nights stay (Shimla, Kalpa, Tabo, Kaza, Chandratal camp, Manali)
Inner line permits & Trip Captain guidance

children.text: Pickup from Delhi/Chandigarh and transfer to Shimla. Check in to Shimla hotel.
Drive along Hindustan-Tibet Highway through Narkanda apple orchards with views of Kinnaur Kailash.
Excursion to Sangla Valley and Chitkul - India's last village on the Tibet border. Return to Kalpa.
Visit Nako Lake, 500-year-old Gue Mummy Monastery, Tabo Monastery, and Dhankar Fort.
Explore Kaza town, iconic Key Monastery, Kibber village, and cross Chicham Bridge.
Visit fossil village Langza, world's highest village Komic, and mail postcards from Hikkim highest post office.
Off-road drive over Kunzum Pass to turquoise Chandratal Lake. Night camping and stargazing.
Drive through Atal Tunnel to Manali. Evening Volvo departure for Delhi.
Arrive in Delhi and board onward flight/train to Mumbai.

importantInformation.title: Altitude & Conditions
details: Spiti is a high altitude cold desert (above 12,000 ft). Hydration is crucial.
Mobile connectivity is mostly BSNL / Jio in Kaza.

title: Nepal with Muktinath Spiritual & Scenic Tour
shortDescription: A spiritual and scenic Nepal journey covering Pokhara, Muktinath and Kathmandu.

children.text: Explore Nepal's most sacred temples and natural wonders: Pashupatinath, Muktinath Dham, Guheshwari, Boudhanath, Phewa Lake, Devi's Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, and Jomsom.

inclusions: AC 17-Seater Tempo Traveller for Nepal transfers

children.text: Board train from Mumbai towards Gorakhpur.

itinerary.title: Gorakhpur to Pokhara Drive

children.text: Pickup from Gorakhpur. Cross Nepal border and drive to scenic Pokhara town. Check in to hotel.

itinerary.stay: Hotel Snow Peak / Similar in Pokhara

children.text: Transfer to Jomsom and drive to Muktinath Temple. Holy dip in 108 Kunda waters and temple Darshan.
Return to Pokhara. Visit Gupteshwor Cave, Devi's Falls, Bindhyabasini Temple, and Phewa Lake boating.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Kathmandu

children.text: Drive to Kathmandu. En route optional Manakamana Temple cable car ride. Check in to Kathmandu hotel.

itinerary.stay: Hotel Rudra View / Similar in Kathmandu

children.text: Visit Pashupatinath Temple, Guheshwari Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Budhanilkantha, and Swayambhunath Stupa.
Drive back to Gorakhpur station for return train journey to Mumbai.

importantInformation.title: ID Requirements
details: Indian citizens must carry original Voter ID card or Passport for Nepal border entry.

title: Mystic Meghalaya Waterfall & Cave Expedition
shortDescription: Cloudy mountains, crystal-clear rivers, waterfalls, caves and unforgettable Northeast adventures.

children.text: Explore Guwahati, Umiam Lake, Shillong, Police Bazaar, Laitlum Grand Canyon, Phe Phe Falls, Krang Suri Falls, Dawki Umngot River, Mawlynnong, Cherrapunjee, Mawsmai & Arwah Caves, Nohkalikai Falls, and the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge.

accommodation: 2N Shillong Guest House + 2N Cherrapunjee + 1N Dawki Riverside Camping
inclusions: Twin/Triple/Quad sharing accommodation (2N Shillong, 2N Cherrapunjee, 1N Dawki Tents)
Trip Captain guidance for group departures
exclusions: Entry fees to waterfalls, caves & living root bridge

children.text: Pickup from Guwahati Airport at 12:00 PM. Drive along Khasi Hills stopping at Umiam Lake. Evening cafe hopping at Shillong Police Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Shillong → Laitlum Canyon → Krang Suri → Dawki

children.text: Visit Laitlum Grand Canyon, Phe Phe Falls & Krang Suri turquoise waterfalls. Drive to Dawki riverside camping by Bangladesh border. Evening bonfire.
Boating & kayaking on crystal clear Umngot River. Visit Mawlynnong clean village and head to rain capital Cherrapunjee.
Explore Mawsmai Cave, Arwah Cave, Wei Sawdong Falls, Nohkalikai Falls, and Seven Sisters Falls.

itinerary.title: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek

children.text: Trek down Tyrna to famous Double Decker Living Root Bridge, natural pools, Rainbow Falls & Blue Lagoon.
Morning visit to Kamakhya Temple. Drop at Guwahati Airport by 4:00 PM for flights after 5:00 PM.

importantInformation.title: Flight Timing
details: Book arrival flight before 12:00 PM on Day 1 and return flight after 5:00 PM on Day 6.

title: Do Dham Yatra (Kedarnath & Badrinath)
shortDescription: A sacred Himalayan pilgrimage to Kedarnath and Badrinath.

children.text: Visit 12 Jyotirlinga Kedarnath and holy Badrinath. Route: Haridwar → Guptkashi → Kedarnath → Guptkashi → Pipalkoti/Joshimath → Badrinath → Haridwar.

inclusions: Haridwar transfers in Tempo Traveller / Private Vehicle
Pure vegetarian meals as per itinerary

children.text: Pickup from Haridwar/Delhi. Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri. Overnight stay in Haridwar.
Drive via Devprayag Sangam, Rudraprayag, and Dhari Devi Temple to Guptkashi.
Jeep to Gaurikund. 22 km trek to Kedarnath Dham. Evening Aarti at temple.
Morning Darshan and trek down to Sonprayag. Return drive to Guptkashi.
Drive to Pipalkoti/Joshimath with optional Chopta view.
Badrinath Temple Darshan, Tapt Kund, and Mana Village exploration.
Drive back to Haridwar for return journey to Mumbai.

title: Kedarnath Dham Spiritual Yatra
shortDescription: A spiritual Himalayan journey to the sacred Kedarnath Dham.

children.text: Dedicated 7-day pilgrimage journey to Kedarnath Temple covering Haridwar Ganga Aarti, Devprayag, Dhari Devi, Sonprayag, Gaurikund, and Kedarnath Darshan.

accommodation: Hotels in Haridwar, Guptkashi & Kedarnath Stay

children.text: Train journey from Mumbai to Delhi. Pickup and transfer to Haridwar. Evening Har Ki Pauri Ganga Aarti.
Drive through Devprayag and Dhari Devi temple to Guptkashi.
Jeep to Gaurikund and begin 16 km trek to Kedarnath Temple. Attend evening Aarti.
Morning Darshan at temple. Trek down to Gaurikund and return to Guptkashi.
Drive back to Delhi railway station for train journey to Mumbai.

importantInformation.title: Packing Advice
details: Pack rain coat, thermal innerwear, and sturdy walking shoes.

title: Tirupati Balaji Sacred Yatra
shortDescription: A spiritual South India journey for Balaji Darshan and sacred temple experiences.

children.text: Explore Sri Venkateswara Temple Tirumala, Shri Kalahasti Temple, Shri Padmavathi Mata Temple, and ISKCON Temple Tirupati with seamless transfers and AC hotel stay.

accommodation: Treebo Sripadhaa Residency / Similar AC Hotel
inclusions: Sleeper / 3AC Class Train tickets (as per option selected)
Sharing AC Vehicle for transfers & sightseeing

children.text: Board Train No. 12163 LTT-MAS Express at 18:40 from LTT Mumbai. Overnight train journey.
Arrive at Renigunta (13:33). Hotel transfer. Sri Venkateswara Temple Tirumala Balaji Darshan.
Visit Shri Kalahasti Temple, Shri Padmavathi Mata Temple, and ISKCON Temple Tirupati.
Morning local market shopping. Transfer to Renigunta station for Train No. 12164 departure at 20:50.
Reach LTT Mumbai around 15:55. Tour ends with divine memories.

importantInformation.title: Temple Rules
details: Original photo ID proof mandatory for temple entry.
Strict traditional Indian dress code required for Tirumala Darshan.
